pose: one wall swung open like a small wing
requested_medium: ceramic cutaway with sculpted cloud layers

composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Make a large celadon ceramic chess rook with one side hinged open like a wing. Inside the hollow body, stack several soft orange cloud layers that are compressed into the cylindrical space. The clouds must feel sculptural and dense, not atmospheric smoke. Keep the crenellated top and flared base clear so the rook remains instantly recognizable. Add a small brass hinge and faint glaze pooling around the ceramic edges. The open wall angles toward the viewer, suggesting a curious invitation without adding a face. Use a dark desaturated blue background and warm interior illumination. Center the object within seventy percent of the square, keeping the opened wing safely inside a circular avatar crop.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
